<thought>To satisfy the tool’s requirement, I’ll query the template catalog specifying that the forward reaction forms new carbon‑carbon single bonds (6‑6) and that existing carbon‑carbon double bonds (6‑6) change order from double to single (2.0→1.0). This matches the Diels‑Alder cycloaddition pattern. The search should return relevant retrosynthetic templates, from which I can pick the one that matches the target molecule and retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
